text.text: Super Mario War is a fan-made multiplayer action game inspired by the Super Mario series. Released in 2003, it turns the traditional platforming gameplay into a competitive arena where players defeat opponents by jumping on their heads. The game features multiple modes, customizable rules, numerous characters, and community-created content. Known for its fast multiplayer gameplay and extensive customization, Super Mario War became one of the most recognized fan projects based on Nintendo's classic platforming series.
